Short Barrel Gyrojet.info: Fits your Gyrojet with a shorter barrel, making an already small handheld rocket launcher even smaller. Costing accuracy and a couple thousand dollars.

CheyTac CQB Barrel.info: Shortened homemade barrel modification for the M200 Intervention. Not suited for long range engagements.

Hecate CQB Barrel.info: Shortened barrel for the CQB Variant of the HECATE II. Not suited for long range engagements.

CTAR Barrel.info:
Shortened barrel for the TAR-21, this barrel makes your TAR-21 into the CTAR-21.

This barrel reduces your long range potential that is typical to the TAR-21 to favour close quarters performance.

Extended Barrel.info: Extends the barrel length, providing greater damage over range at the cost of handling.

Police Barrel.info: The perfect barrel fitting for a crime fighting law abiding mercenary ready to bring the long arm of justice to this tainted land.

BFG Carbine Barrel.info:
A shortened barrel that turns your gun into the BFG 50 CARBINE!
This lighter 22 inch barrel increases walk speed and handling speeds at a mild cost of bullet speed and penetration.
Accurate enough to still be useful for sniping!

Integral AK9.info:
An integral suppressor designed for the AK-9 platform.

Improves performance at close range at the cost of ranged performance and velocity. Excellent masking.

1858C Long Barrel.info: Long barrel designed specifically for the 1858 line of revolvers. Increases range and bullet velocity but with worse handling.

NTW Obrez Barrel.info: An even shorter barrel for the NTW-20, made by a deaf gunsmith. Provides an exaggerated version of the short barrel stats, good and bad. You are able to stand while aiming with this equipped.

LUTY Rifled Barrel.info:
Adds rifling to your barrel which entirely eliminates the issue of tumbling bullets.
Cannot be used with muzzle or suppressor attachments.

Taurus Barrel.info:
The Taurus carbine kit barrel placed onto your revovler.
Greater recoil control, worse maneuverability and hipfire control. Equips slower.

PPSH-41 Obrez Barrel.info: Completely cut off most of your barrel to form a very homemade looking pistol. Expect close range performance to increase drastically but long range to suffer.

Integral CSMG.info: An integral suppressor for the M635 SMG. Provides excellent radar masking and mild recoil and range bonuses, but has worse handling.

Short Barrel REX.info: Reduce your barrel length to give yourself the legendary MP412 REX. Despite never reaching sales, it has seen the faces of battlefields across the world. You'll never be in bad company with this by your side!

KSG 25 Extension.info:
Lengthened barrel and tube(s) specially designed to make the KSG 25.
Works like a mix of extended tube and the longer barrel.
May impede speed, including aim, reload, and movement...

Long Barrel (Rev).info: Longer barrel design made for revolvers. Better range and accuracy. Worse handling and equip speed. Yee-haw...

Short Barrel (AR).info:
Shortened barrel best suited for close range engagements.
Better aim speed and hipfire control but worse range and bullet speed. Better movement.

Long Barrel Gyrojet.info:
Extended barrel for extended rocket flinging purposes.
This longer barrel is great for solving the Gyrojets primary issue at the cost of performance.

Long Barrel (PISTOL).info: Lengthened barrel best suited for longer range engagements. Attachment flattens out the damage curve of the weapon giving said weapon a more gradual damage reduction over distance.

Long Barrel (MC51).info:
Lengthened barrel best suited for longer range engagements.
Better Range and bullet speed, but worse close range performance and aim speed. Worse movement.

OSS Suppressor.info:
35 stud detection radius.

Covert Ops suppressor built during WW2 to accommodate the M3 SMG, and adapted for use on the M3A1.
Improved performance at range with decent masking.

Air Service Barrel.info: Barrel used on the Air Service M1903 Springfield rifle. Reduces weapon weight due to the lack of extra parts on the weapon, faster aimspeed.

M10 Carbine Barrel.info: A familiar looking barrel for the Carbine Variant of the MAC-10. Further positives but also negative aspects than the typical long barrel!

Long Barrel (SHOTGUN).info:
Longer barrel best suited for longer range, perfect for sporting purposes.
Better range and bullet speed, but worse close range performance and aim speed. Worse movement.
